description: Plan Przeciwdziałania Skutkom Suszy (PPSS) is a dataset listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Państwowe Gospodarstwo Wodne Wody Polskie. The dataset includes: Maps of atmospheric, agricultural, hydrological, hydrogeological drought hazard classes and a map of total drought hazard. There is also a map showing investment tasks supporting drought mitigation, i.e. Coverage: Państwowe Gospodarstwo Wodne Wody Polskie. The portal shows the English title as "Drought Effects Counteracting Plan (DECP)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Państwowe Gospodarstwo Wodne Wody Polskie. Its keywords include PPSS, wody polskie, susza, stop suszy, PGWWP. The listing shows 6 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2024-05-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
